items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: But Marshall Lawrence, last time I was there, I went there, he told me, he said, oh, Tom, he said, hey you fool with them fellas no more.

ctx.x: So, and they used to come down here every carnival didn't play. And every carnival would come, and every time they come down here they would win the prize. Is that with your father's band? My father's band. Every time they come down here they used to wear a red, a red uniform, red outfit you know. So I used to come down here every year carnival they would come down. For eleven years when you used to have carnival they didn't have enough bands. They used to send off and get band different parts you know. Sure. You…
Well was that that strip and stuff?

items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: They had a Thomas. I think Thomas started with them.

ctx.x: And who did he play with?

Well, they had a little band my brother played with them. They had a Thomas. I think Thomas started with them. I think he did. If I'm not mistaken. My brother played the violin. And he played the bass. And one of the man in my band played trombone. The same trombone player I have. Blassey. They all younger than I was. They were younger than I was. And then he moved to the city.
Where is Dave from? What town?
